reviewer: landing_flight_ui agent; author rereviews and peer reviews distinguished per file
scope: All current authored privacy/src non-prover modules, privacy/circuits and privacy/scripts, plus package configuration. This is a bounded code review, not an external cryptographic audit or a claim that the entire repository was independently audited.

findings.problem: Both scripts previously accepted an arbitrary CLI file and unconditionally attributed any successfully verified transcript to one fixed PSE URL/commit. A different valid transcript would receive false source metadata; this did not bypass full transcript verification. Key preparation also trusted arbitrary local verified/hash provenance while unconditionally describing its phase1 as Published PPoT.
findings.correction: Both entrypoints now require the selected exact 302083218-byte SHA256 9693220206afab749e3d88d4ab5fdf5d36120ea102e7e587ccea0e7a5208e711 before full verification and again before fixed-source provenance is written. Shared fingerprint selection does not return verified:true. Key preparation now checks the actual selected input and requires its recorded source URL/repository/commit and fingerprint to match before proceeding. Slow verification and key preparation use script-relative defaults.
findings.verification: Red observations: ordinary verification reached snarkjs Invalid File format for unrelated bytes; key preparation reached provenance file lookup before rejecting the input fingerprint. The corrected focused suite passes6/6: all three entrypoints reject unrelated bytes, exact fixed-source selection accepts only the selected fingerprint, altered source metadata is rejected, and a same-size different file is rejected by hashing. Actual selected artifact preflight matched. The453-second full transcript verification and key generation were not rerun; cryptographic verification logic/artifacts and historical raw provenance remain unchanged.

conclusionBoundary: No additional exploitable bypass was identified in the reviewed snapshot. This is not evidence that no bugs exist; authorship overlap, dependency assumptions and untested operational paths remain explicit.

limits: Synthetic constraint fixture; no standalone asset-transfer function.

limits: Dependency internals and transitive source are excluded from this authored-source pass; a package audit cannot prove cryptographic safety.

files.reviewedBoundary: Pinned Circom package/version, O2 flags, source/dependency/artifact hashes, child exit handling.
limits: A local build manifest is not a signed reproducible release or independent supply-chain attestation; generated WASM/R1CS not line-by-line reviewed.

files.reviewedBoundary: Exact selected PSE byte count and SHA256 from actual streamed input, matching local provenance source fields, and no verified:true from fingerprint or metadata validation.
limits: Fingerprint selection is not transcript verification. Local file/OS integrity remains a trusted operator boundary.

files.reviewedBoundary: Actual selected PSE input fingerprint and matching fixed-source provenance, script-relative defaults, source/artifact hash checks, in-process contribution, no-overwrite outputs, actual R1CS/phase1 zkey verification and exact public counts.
limits: Local unsigned provenance/build files assume a trusted operator workspace. Single-operator development phase2 is not an independent trusted setup.

files.reviewedBoundary: In-process contribution entropy, no-overwrite paths, full contributed phase1 verification, phase2 preparation and bounded local worker pressure.
limits: Local fallback development setup only. This script does not write a claim that its prepared phase2 output independently passed full verification.

files.reviewedBoundary: Actual local browser bundling/server, artifact-only allowlist, no-POST/outbound assertions, strict console/page/HTTP/CSP reporting and actual worker close evidence.
limits: Headless desktop Chromium evidence only; no phone benchmark. Source-reviewed reporting is not a general proof of absence of every possible side channel.

files.reviewedBoundary: Selected input fingerprint before full upstream verification and again before fixed-source attribution; exclusive provenance write. Default input resolves relative to the script, independently of shell working directory.

files.reviewedBoundary: Development schema/count gates, actual WASM/zkey/VK digest comparison and no-overwrite public-path manifest.

files.reviewedBoundary: Accepted-record order, ciphertext digest, profile, append roots, root history, duplicate commitments/nullifiers, revocation reconstruction, clone-before-commit.
limits: Requires independently authenticated accepted records/checkpoint; consistency is not RPC authenticity. No archival retrieval implementation.

files.reviewedBoundary: Exact signed authority quorum and branded requests; accepted-ledger record binding; field-specific audit offsets; atomic replay claim; fresh ledger; requester-private X25519/HKDF/AES-GCM replies.
limits: Trusted authority policy, ledger reader and durable replay callback remain outside the cryptographic helper. Trustee collusion is not prevented by request scope.

files.reviewedBoundary: Fixed Argon2id costs, copied byte inputs, AES-GCM AAD, strict context and envelope bounds, wrong-password/tamper failures.
limits: Password entropy, physical memory erasure and real-phone memory constraints are not established by these helpers.

files.reviewedBoundary: Local proof/result public-vector comparison; private WeakMap handles; draft/note backup; exact record anchors; incoming decryption, commitment/view binding and zero dummy sentinel.
limits: Prove/verify and ledger anchors are trusted adapters. Restored drafts/notes are not current chain membership or unspent-state evidence; note backups are not complete key backups.

files.reviewedBoundary: Legacy structural disclosure request bounds, exact domain/epoch/freshness/one-record/no-wildcard scope and distinct trustee identifiers.
limits: Returns UnverifiedDisclosureRequest only; its P-256-shaped recipient data is not an implemented HPKE or authorized disclosure protocol.

files.reviewedBoundary: Canonical field/key/ciphertext values; exact supported lengths; non-aliasing nonce bound; upstream encrypt and authenticated decrypt interoperability.
limits: This validates and invokes the pinned Poseidon cipher; it is not an independent cryptographic audit of that cipher or the novel composition.

files.reviewedBoundary: Tagged network/deployment/address encoding, canonical raw IDs and Poseidon conversion of SHA256 limbs; revocation-key domain binding.
limits: Does not authenticate a remote network or deployed contract; the caller must pin the intended scope.

files.reviewedBoundary: Explicit legacy structural exports and fail-closed suite facade.
limits: Local v2 cryptography uses explicit module imports; this facade does not activate a production private-transfer suite.

files.reviewedBoundary: Strict note24/core23 encodings, subgroup points, sparse tree bounds, note-bound nullifiers, actual EdDSA-Poseidon relation and all six spend modes including Envoy fee prohibition.
limits: Reference evaluation is not proof verification: full path, encrypted-witness and inactive-input constraints are also enforced by the circuit. No constant-time JS guarantee.

files.reviewedBoundary: Owned directory/ancestor checks, no-follow exclusive files, single-link ownership/mode validation, atomic claims, file/directory fsync and permanent failure state.
limits: Durability assumes the documented local POSIX filesystem. Same-UID/root rollback, hostile filesystems and distributed quorum replication remain out of scope.

files.reviewedBoundary: Pinned profile/scope/vault binding, full bounded archive reconstruction, snapshot consistency, spent filtering, cancellation/yielding and cleanup of newly created handles on failure.
limits: Reader is an independently trusted accepted-ledger adapter. 100000-record/revocation limits fail rather than truncate; no live archive availability or ledger restoration is supplied here.

files.reviewedBoundary: Legacy canonical codec, exact byte/integer encodings, counts and duplicates, intrinsic bounded byte snapshot, unsupported/trailing data rejection.
limits: ParsedStatement is structural validation only; no funds/proof acceptance is established by the legacy parser.

files.reviewedBoundary: All-roster signed abort-only Feldman DKG, VSS, aggregate/degree nonidentity, common transcript acceptance, point/subgroup checks, bound DLEQs and distinct-trustee point interpolation.
limits: Authenticated private share delivery and independent custody are external. Abort/restart bias/liveness are not solved; an authorized or colluding threshold can decrypt other epoch records.

files.reviewedBoundary: Exact records, dense arrays, bounded canonical integers/hex, domain binding and frozen copied structures.
limits: Designed for data validation, not a sandbox for hostile executable objects/proxies already running in the same JS context.

files.reviewedBoundary: Independent CSPRNG key roles, strict restored material, owner/scope/profile binding, grant extension and exact complete-backup comparison.
limits: Backup checking proves supplied bytes restore keys, not that a user saved a file. Old backups cannot recover later grants; forgetting a handle does not physically erase JS secrets.

files.reviewedBoundary: Empty installed-suite registry and unconditional unavailable activation/proof boundary.
limits: This is the historical fail-closed production facade, distinct from the separately reviewed local development Groth16 adapter.

files.reviewedBoundary: Fresh nonzero secrets/randomness, note/public/cipher ordering, membership/append paths, subgroup preimages, ECDH/KDF and encryption equality for real notes and all-zero dummy slots; domain-bound revocation witness.
limits: Explicit deterministic test randomness is only for synthetic fixtures. Host acceptance, freshness and deployed configuration must still be checked independently.

evidenceInterpretation: Existing real browser report passed37 in-browser and8 harness checks for four actual local Groth16 flows with vault/draft/note recovery, changed-public rejection and one-worker cancellation; no new browser run in this pass.

Existing independent verifier evidence covers17 genuine public fixtures, point/scalar canonicality, zero-L algebra and an actual threshold-disclosure proof composition. Prover files are excluded from this source pass.

Existing full phase1 provenance proves the recorded selected transcript was checked through all upstream powers/pairings/contributions with parity-checked native hash acceleration. The current metadata correction does not rewrite that historical evidence.

Pool resource comparison is local WASM execution against a recorded public coefficient snapshot; its own notMeasured fields retain signed-envelope, live simulation/inclusion, archival restoration and fee/contention limits.
Old helper-coverage snapshots may precede current authorization/recovery changes; their path/hash pairs are historical evidence, not automatically current-source coverage.

The browser entry and browser harness were author-rereviewed here; their paired source/runtime evidence and prover boundary also have parent/second-agent review. These reviews do not make this author-owned portion an independent external audit.
untestedOrTrustedBoundaries: No independent external cryptographic audit, formal soundness proof, independently contributed Agyion phase2 ceremony or real independent trustee committee.
The fixed single-operator development keys do not authorize mainnet deployment or prove toxic-waste destruction. Trusted local build/provenance files are not a signed release channel.
Public bridge amounts/accounts/assets, fees, nullifiers, commitments, record timing and network metadata remain observable. Encrypted internal fields are not a blanket anonymity guarantee.
A colluding threshold can decrypt other records in the same epoch. Request scope is enforced by honest operators; it is not a cryptographic restriction on a colluding quorum.
DKG private authenticated delivery, trustee independence/custody, complaint recovery, distributed restart/rotation and real dispute authorization are not supplied by local helpers.
Archive readers and accepted-record adapters must authenticate pinned network/pool/profile and checkpoint. Missing history fails recovery; untrusted self-consistent RPC data is not sufficient.
POSIX replay claims assume the documented filesystem/owner boundary; rollback by the same OS identity/root, NFS behavior and distributed-store consensus are not tested here.

JavaScript bigint timing and physical secret erasure are not guaranteed. Browser worker cancellation proves termination/no returned proof, not erasure or cancellation of an already submitted transaction.
Desktop Chromium proof/backup performance is measured elsewhere; no real-phone resource/cancellation/backup usability evidence is claimed.
No private-pool client adapter/submission/IndexedDB implementation is covered by this privacy-directory ledger; those files are owned and reviewed separately by another agent.

No new live transaction, signing, deployment, ceremony, browser run or full test-suite run was performed in this pass. Only the bounded provenance regression6/6 and actual input fingerprint preflight ran after the correction.
